name: feast-mobile
description: Feast iOS and Android apps (Capacitor shells around the live Feast web app)

scripts.sync: npm run build && npm run sync:diner && npm run sync:partner
scripts.copy: npm run build && (cd diner && npx cap copy) && (cd partner && npx cap copy)
scripts.open:diner:ios: cd diner && npx cap open ios
scripts.open:diner:android: cd diner && npx cap open android
scripts.open:partner:ios: cd partner && npx cap open ios
scripts.open:partner:android: cd partner && npx cap open android
scripts.assets: node shared/build-assets.mjs && (cd diner && npx capacitor-assets generate --ios --android) && (cd partner && npx capacitor-assets generate --ios --android)
scripts.apk:diner: npm run sync:diner && cd diner/android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:partner: npm run sync:partner && cd partner/android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.aab:diner: npm run sync:diner && cd diner/android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.aab:partner: npm run sync:partner && cd partner/android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run copy && node shared/check.mjs
